prompt:

Classic restrained 16-bit bitmap menu appearance, uniform square-pixel grid, crisp aliased block glyphs, no smooth vector curves, no gradients or glows.
Preserve exact logo shape, font layout, sizes, spacing, centered positions and icons from source. Text verbatim RUSHITADEL / 게임 시작 / 이어하기 / 설정 / 게임 종료. Preserve the entire dark blue-purple actual-game stone tilemap background and cliff borders exactly, unchanged brightness and composition. Keep Continue disabled. No characters, bullets or new decorative elements. Same landscape frame. Result must visibly look matte and flat, not illuminated.
